dedupe_keys.name: vulcan scope 2 electricity consumption carbon emissions

description: Northern Arizona University publishes Vulcan-scope 2 estimates of carbon dioxide emissions associated with electricity consumption. The collection covers US census block groups for 2019–2021, separating residential, commercial and industrial uses and providing state aggregates. Nine GeoPackage and CSV files are publicly accessible at no cost under the repository’s CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 licence. These estimates can support spatial emissions baselines and comparisons for electricity-transition simulations using model-pypsa and platform-qgis. A caveat is that the values downscale larger-area estimates, not directly measuring every block group. Electricity-accounting boundaries and sector allocation affect comparisons with other inventories. The paper names a more permissive licence, so the repository terms must remain visible. The two R scripts described in the paper are absent from the current deposit. No emissions files were downloaded.
